purpose: Structural integrity: the compiler reports a withheld inference instead of failing its own self-validation.

rules.trigger: The internal label for a candidate note that attributes motive or purpose ("motive", "motivated", "in order to hide", "wanted to", "tried to") is "attributed_purpose" instead of a word that the graph self-validation forbids.
rules.limitation: Covers this one label. Other inference labels are unchanged; untested labels may still trip self-validation.
rules.false_positive_risk: None added: the detection pattern is unchanged; only the label text changes.
rules.owner_decision_for_expansion: Any widening of the trigger, any new pattern, or any change of outcome requires a recorded owner decision and a new sealed scenario set.
